name: By Faith

provenance.detail: All thirteen inspected sermon thumbnails display the By Faith series artwork; the immediately preceding channel upload, The Verdict Is In, uses different artwork.

The captions connect the messages week by week through Hebrews: We See Jesus identifies Preeminent as the launch, The New and Living Way counts nine weeks, and Family Resemblance closes as the finale after thirteen weeks.

description: Thirteen sermons through Hebrews 1–13 on Christ’s supremacy, priesthood, new covenant, persevering faith, and the gospel-shaped life of the church.
note: The channel sequence begins with Preeminent immediately after the differently branded The Verdict Is In and ends with Family Resemblance, whose captions identify it as the finale after thirteen weeks.
